question: Who was awarded the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Award, the highest honour in Indian cinema, at the 70th National Film Awards ceremony on 8 October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mithun Chakraborty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Veteran actor **Mithun Chakraborty** was honored with the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award**, the highest recognition in Indian cinema, during the **70th National Film Awards** ceremony held on **8 October 2024**.
 
• The award was presented by the **President of India**, **Droupadi Murmu**, at **Vigyan Bhawan** in **New Delhi**. **Mithun Chakraborty** is the **54th recipient** of this prestigious award for his massive contribution to the film industry.
 
• The announcement of his selection was made earlier on **September 30, 2024**, by the Union Minister for Information and Broadcasting, **Ashwini Vaishnaw**.
 
• The selection was finalized by a distinguished jury consisting of five members: **Asha Parekh**, **Khushbu Sundar**, and **Vipul Amrutlal Shah**, among others.
 
• **Mithun Chakraborty** made his acting debut in the **1976** film **Mrigayaa**, directed by **Mrinal Sen**, for which he won his first **National Film Award for Best Actor**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Mithun Chakraborty.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dadasaheb Phalke Award:**
 
 
• Instituted in **1969**, the award commemorates **Dhandiraj Govind Phalke**, popularly known as the **Father of Indian Cinema**, who directed India’s first full-length feature film, **Raja Harishchandra**, in **1913**.
 
• The award is presented annually at the **National Film Awards** ceremony by the **Directorate of Film Festivals**, an organization set up by the **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**.
 
• The first recipient of this award was **Devika Rani**, known as the "First Lady of Indian Cinema," who was honored at the **17th National Film Awards**.
 
• The award comprises a **Swarna Kamal** (Golden Lotus) medallion, a shawl, and a cash prize of **Rs. 15 lakh** (which was increased from Rs. 10 lakh recently).
 
 
 
• **Previous Honorees:**
 
 
• Before Mithun Chakraborty, the **53rd Dadasaheb Phalke Award** was conferred upon veteran actress **Waheeda Rehman** for the year **2021**.
 
• Other notable recipients mentioned in the options include **Amitabh Bachchan**, who received the honor in **2018**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Career and Achievements:**
 
 
• **Mithun Chakraborty** has won **three National Film Awards** in his career: Best Actor for **Mrigayaa** (**1976**), Best Actor for **Tahader Katha** (**1992**), and Best Supporting Actor for **Swami Vivekananda** (**1998**).
 
• He is globally renowned for his role in the **1982** blockbuster **Disco Dancer**, which gained him a massive fan following in countries like the **Soviet Union** and **Africa**.
 
• In **April 2024**, he was also conferred with the **Padma Bhushan**, India's third-highest civilian award, by the **Government of India**.
 
• Known affectionately as **Mithun Da**, he has acted in more than **350 films** across various languages including **Hindi**, **Bengali**, **Odia**, **Bhojpuri**, and **Tamil**.
